title: Fix Stop Button Desync and Distinguish Intermediate Step Commentary from Final Response
commitMessage: fix(drawer): address review caveats on intervening tools and subagent abort cleanup
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Fixed Stop Button desynchronization and premature 'Ответ агента' card rendering in AgentConsoleDrawer: (1) Derived isRunning reactively from task.status === 'running' || hasRunningTool || isAgentActive, managing activeAgentTaskIds in drawerStore across all agent lifecycle events; (2) Implemented in-flight tool abort cleanup marking running tools in both parent task and active subagent as failed with 'Прервано пользователем'; (3) Created isFinalResponseItem helper in DrawerActivityStream distinguishing intermediate commentary/intent before and between tools from true terminal responses; (4) Styled intermediate commentary as natural unboxed step explanation ('Пояснение агента' with Bot icon, timestamp, and unboxed markdown) and reserved the collapsible '✨ Ответ агента' card strictly for terminal output; (5) Added markFinalResponse in drawerStore with intervening tool guard ensuring past commentary is never overwritten; (6) Verified with npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors).

caveatsAddressed.caveat: Intervening tool call mutation in markFinalResponse
caveatsAddressed.resolution: Added hasInterveningTools check verifying whether any tool activity occurred after lastOutput; if tools intervened, a separate final output item is appended instead of mutating earlier commentary.

caveatsAddressed.caveat: Active subagent tool cleanup on abort
caveatsAddressed.resolution: Updated handleAbortAgent to loop over activeSubagentId toolExecutions and proactively mark all running tools as failed with 'Прервано пользователем'.

rootCauses.cause: Stop Button Desynchronization & Inactive Running State
rootCauses.detail: The Stop button state relied solely on task.status === 'running'. During active tool invocations, background subagent turns, or asynchronous event propagation, task.status could be out-of-sync or set to 'idle' while the backend process was actively executing. Furthermore, aborting did not transition in-flight running tools to a terminated status.
rootCauses.resolution: Derived isRunning reactively from task.status === 'running' || hasRunningTool || isAgentActive. Tracked activeAgentTaskIds in drawerStore across all agent events, and swept all in-flight tools to failed with 'Прервано пользователем' upon abort.

rootCauses.cause: Premature 'Ответ агента' Card Rendering for Intermediate Step Commentary
rootCauses.detail: DrawerActivityStream rendered every item of type 'output' within the prominent collapsible '✨ Ответ агента' card. When LLMs provided natural thinking or step commentary preceding or intervening between tool calls, the UI treated each intermediate comment as a final deliverable.
rootCauses.resolution: Implemented isFinalResponseItem helper checking for subsequent tools, outputs, or unended turns. Intermediate commentary is rendered unboxed as 'Пояснение агента' with Bot icon, and only the terminal turn response is encased in the '✨ Ответ агента' card.
